overview_description.description:
As a company, OUSTA is a trusted network of limousine drivers/companies to help people move easier. OUSTA only relies on licensed and professional drivers to provide users with convenient, reliable, cost effective, and safe rides. 
Originally Turkish for Master Craftsman and Teacher, the word Ousta was used to call upon teachers and professionals, then later it has been evolved and used as a title to praise “masters” and “experts” in their fields especially hand-crafted professions, but it is used widely as a title for drivers, specifically, boss of Drivers (best driver), or an expert and a professional driver.
